patch.value: Require exact all-source 100/100/100/100 coverage and strict quality gates

The current coverage gate skips scripts and reports only index.ts at 89.66 percent lines, 87.74 percent branches, and 90.76 percent functions. It has no independently reported statements result, and release:check does not enforce ESLint, duplication, or broader static/security analyzers. This blocks any exact all-source or production-ready claim.

Inventory every executable TypeScript and JavaScript source; replace or explicitly justify JavaScript; measure statements, branches, functions, and lines across every executable source at exact 100 percent; make the gate fail when a source is added or removed from measurement; add strict lint, duplication and security/static gates with no blanket suppression; mutation-check the gate; keep tests behavior-driven and non-duplicative
Current release gate and source inventory are measured on main.
Run npm run coverage and inspect coverage-gate DEFAULT_SKIP_DIRS plus package thresholds.
All executable repository source is measured at exact 100/100/100/100 and every strict quality gate is mandatory.
Only index.ts is measured at 89.66/87.74/90.76; scripts are excluded, statements are not independently reported, and broader strict gates are absent.
A green release gate can coexist with untested source and below-mandate coverage, so it cannot support a production-ready claim.
